title: 第二十章 零尾第二十二章 试炼照美冥
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
冥帝嘿嘿一笑，他确实是有意的。他嗅了嗅手掌，那美妙绝伦的触感和清香似乎还萦绕其上。
照美冥见波风冥帝如此轻薄她，心中羞意更甚，气急地站起身，"火遁，火球之术"一抬手两个火球术射向正一脸陶醉的冥帝。
冥帝大笑着一个卧倒，两个火球从头上飞过窜入了身后的森林中。
"哇，你乱放火，起森林火灾了怎么办？"冥帝笑道。
照美冥哼了一声，正想再接着放几个。突然，森林里传来一声巨吼，震得地面都阵阵颤动，树上的叶子枝条更是如下雨般纷纷落下。一只带着面具像蛇一样，面具上刻有零字的怪物狂暴地撞倒大片树木钻了出来，它凶狠的眼神紧紧盯着冥帝和照美冥，一步一步朝他们走来，冥帝眼尖的发现这是零尾！
这不是因为在空中要塞的吗？怎么会在这里？难道空之国的忍者还没有将它收服？
照美冥脸色一变，惊道："不好，这家伙好强，我们快跑。"
零尾？
出自剧场版《羁绊》，漫画中并未出现。由黑暗查克拉组成，运用身体组成的触手攻击目标。跟《千与千寻》中的无脸男有点相似，体型巨大如一辆双层巴士。出现在火影忍者第五部剧场版-羁绊中，漫画原著中并无此尾兽，属于原创角色。某种意义上来说是一个庞大的空中要塞，同时也是怪物，被神农寄放在了阿玛鲁体内，依靠人们心中的黑暗而产生巨大的黑暗查克拉。在空之国要塞-吴哥要塞中有一个由零尾的力能作为能源超级重炮，威力能将一座山开一个大洞，但最后被旋涡鸣人用多重影分身术破坏。
与一尾至九尾不同，并非由十尾变化而来，因此不属于尾兽之列。
可力量却可以和尾兽相提并论！
冥帝和照美冥开始狂奔，笑话，这零尾如此厉害，冥帝想着自己现在才比一般中忍厉害一点点而已，上去不是去送死吗？
那零尾见得两人逃跑，身上泛起黑色的光芒，狂吼一声，光芒砸在地上。
地面一阵猛烈地震动，土块如蝗虫般遮天敝日地从地面上飞起砸向狂奔中的两人。
"溶遁，溶遁结界。"照美冥快速结印，用溶遁将两人护住，土块彭彭彭地砸在结界上，荡起一层层如水波状的波纹。
"我靠，这是下的什么雨啊。"冥帝看着不断从空中落下的土块苦笑道，如果他可以运用轮回之眼，或者是斩魄刀，就算十个零尾他也照样可以收拾。
但现在，他面对零尾，真的是无能为力！
终于，当最后一块土块砸在溶遁结界上时，结界波的一声破碎了。
"我们赶快走吧。"冥帝道。
照美冥轻轻一叹，幽幽道："我刚刚查克拉耗得差不多了，现在是有心无力了。"照美冥是个女的，而且还不是人柱力，没有那么充沛查克拉！

看着不远处狰狞的零尾，冥帝暗叹一口气，看来这回得拼命了。
这时照美冥望了望冥帝，转向冥帝道："冥帝，你记住我了吗？"
冥帝不知所谓的点点头，再次看到这张天使与魔鬼融合的脸蛋，他的心里竟涌出一丝的暖意。
"那你赶快走吧，我来抵挡这零尾。"照美冥一个跨步拦在了冥帝前面！
照美冥"溶遁?溶怪之术！"溶遁为水、土两种性质性质变化结和。吐出有溶解性的粘稠液体。
冥帝记得这个连佐助的须佐能乎都可以溶解，虽然效果并不突出。在溶遁的力量之下，零尾缓缓的向后退去！
但当着照美冥以为零尾就此走了的时候，零尾又是凶猛的冲了上来。"什么？"照美冥一惊，她知道自己查克拉所剩不多，可能奈何不了零尾。她只希望能够为冥帝争取到一点时间逃跑，这个就是她此时最大的心愿。
冥帝看着挡在他身前的瘦弱，心中不由一动，要知道她是水影，可还是个柔弱的女人啊，她此时的举动就是在用生命护卫自己的安全，因为一旦她的查克拉耗尽，她将会被零尾撕成碎片。如果照美冥再问他到底娶不娶她，他一定会坚定的回答："娶！"
眼见得照美冥所施展的忍术越来越弱，心急如焚的冥帝强迫自己冷静下来观察零尾的罩门在哪，零尾看去全身很软，其实全身上下如铁，就连照美冥的溶遁也很难伤害它分毫。
照美冥感觉自己的查克拉越来越弱了，她转过头想看看冥帝走了没有，却不想一回头仍见他呆头呆脑地站在原地傻傻看着零尾。照美冥心中一惊，这家伙莫不是吓傻了，他如果没逃走那自己的努力不是白费了。
"混蛋，你怎么还在这里？还不快跑。"照美冥吼道。
"你这个笨妞闭上你的嘴，谁叫你自以为伟大拦在我前面的，我他妈现在要是走了还算一个男人吗？"冥帝喝道，眼睛却不停地在零尾身上打转。
"这个傻瓜，那我们就死在一起好了。"查克拉已接近枯竭了，照美冥听了冥帝的话，心情即是恼怒又是甜蜜。恼他为什么不逃走，又庆幸自己没有看错人。
看照美冥越来越弱了，零售晃了晃它的大脑袋，它看着前面的一对男女，神情又变得狂暴起来。
冥帝看着如一辆重型坦克狂奔过来的零尾，眼神渐渐变得冰冷！
感受到冥帝身上那令人发悸的气息，零尾的动作一缓，竟在十米开外停了十来，望着这个渺小的人类，它不明白刚刚还弱小的小子怎么一下变得危险起来。一般级别较高的通灵兽都有一定的智商，级别越高智商也就越高，零尾感受到了强者的气势本能地停了下来。
冥帝紧紧盯着零尾，先下手为强，后下手遭殃。"雷切！"
"螺旋丸！"
冥帝一手雷切，一手旋落丸，最后终于是结合在了一起！
冥帝拿出特制苦无，虽然飞雷神还没有成功，但成功率怎么也有三成！

飞雷神发出！
砰的一声，冥帝转眼到了零尾面前，那冒着寒气的白色火焰“寂灭之火！”劈在了零尾的身体上，零尾巨大身子倒飞而去，随即感觉一阵寒冷，便是惊骇的看了波风冥帝一眼，这到底是什么妖孽，接着便是急急忙忙的逃走了。

content_en:
Emperor Hades chuckled, he did mean it. He sniffed the palm of his hand, and the wonderful touch and fragrance seemed to still linger on it.
Terumi Mei felt even more ashamed when she saw Namikaze Mei-Ei being so frivolous towards her. She angrily stood up and used "Fire Release, Fireball Technique". She raised her hand and shot two fireballs at Mei-Ei who was looking intoxicated.
Emperor Hades laughed and fell down, two fireballs flew over his head and rushed into the forest behind him.
"Wow, what if you set fire randomly and started a forest fire?" Emperor Hades laughed.
Terumi Mei snorted and was about to play a few more. Suddenly, a loud roar came from the forest, causing the ground to tremble, and the leaves and branches on the trees fell like rain. A snake-like monster wearing a mask with the word "zero" engraved on the mask violently knocked down a large tree and came out. Its fierce eyes stared at Hades and Terumi Mei, and walked towards them step by step. Hades' sharp eyes discovered that it was Zero Tails!
Isn't this because we are in the Sky Fortress? Why are you here? Haven't the ninjas of Sky Country conquered it yet?
Terumi Mei's expression changed and she said in surprise: "No, this guy is so strong, let's run away."
Zero tail?
It comes from the theatrical version of "Bond" and does not appear in the comics. Made up of dark chakra, it uses tentacles made of its body to attack targets. Somewhat similar to the faceless man in "Spirited Away", he is as huge as a double-decker bus. It appears in the fifth Naruto movie: Bonds. This tailed beast does not exist in the original comics and is an original character. In a sense, it is a huge aerial fortress, and it is also a monster. It was placed in Amaru's body by Shennong, and it relies on the darkness in people's hearts to generate huge dark chakra. In the Sky Country Fortress-Angkor Fortress, there was a super heavy cannon powered by Zero Tail's power. It was powerful enough to open a big hole in a mountain, but it was finally destroyed by Uzumaki Naruto using the multiple shadow clone technique.
Unlike the one to nine tails, it did not change from the ten tails, so it is not among the tailed beasts.
But its power is comparable to that of a tailed beast!
Hades and Terumi Mei began to run wildly. It was a joke. This Zero-Tail was so powerful. Hades thought that he was only a little more powerful than the average chuunin. Wouldn't he go up there and die?
When Zero Tails saw the two running away, a black light glowed on his body, he roared wildly, and the light hit the ground.
The ground shook violently, and clods of earth flew up from the ground like locusts, covering the sky and hitting the two people who were running wildly.
"Melt Escape, Melt Escape Barrier." Terumi Mei quickly formed a seal and used Melt Escape to protect the two of them. The clods of earth smashed against the barrier, causing ripples like water ripples.
"Holy shit, what kind of rain is this." Emperor Hades looked at the clods of soil falling from the sky and said with a bitter smile. If he could use the Eye of Samsara or a Zanpakutō, he could still take care of ten Zero-Tails.
But now, facing Zero-Tail, he is really powerless!
Finally, when the last piece of soil hit the melting barrier, the barrier wave shattered.
"Let's leave quickly." Emperor Hades said.
Terumi Mei sighed softly and said quietly: "I have almost exhausted my chakra just now, and now I am powerless." Terumi Mei is a woman, and she is not a Jinchuuriki, so she doesn't have that much chakra!
Looking at the ferocious Zero Tails not far away, Emperor Hades sighed secretly. It seemed that he had to fight hard this time.
At this time, Terumi Mei looked at Emperor Ming, turned to Emperor Ming and said: "Emperor Ming, do you remember me?"
Emperor Hades nodded without knowing what he meant. When he saw this face of angel and devil again, a trace of warmth surged in his heart.
"Then you go quickly, I will resist this zero tail. " Terumi Mei stepped in front of Emperor Hades!
Terumi Mei's "Melt Escape? The art of melting monsters!" "Solubility is the combination of changes in the properties of water and soil. It spits out a viscous liquid with solubility.
Emperor Hades remembered that even Sasuke's Susanoo could be dissolved, although the effect was not outstanding. Under the power of Melting Release, Zero Tails slowly retreated!
But just when Terumi Mei thought Zero-Tail had just left, Zero-Tail rushed forward ferociously. "What? " Terumi Mei was shocked. She knew that she didn't have much chakra left, and she might not be able to do anything to Zero-Tail. She just hoped to buy some time for Hades to escape. This was her biggest wish at this time.
Emperor Hades looked at the thin figure standing in front of him, and couldn't help but feel in his heart. You must know that she is Mizukage, but she is still a weak woman. Her actions at this time are to protect her own safety with her life, because once her chakra is exhausted, she will be torn into pieces by Zero Tails. If Terumi Mei asked him again whether he would marry her or not, he would definitely answer firmly: "Marry!" "
Seeing that Terumi Mei's ninjutsu was getting weaker and weaker, the anxious Hades forced himself to calm down and observe where Zero Tails' shield was. Zero Tails looked soft all over, but in fact, the whole body was as iron as iron. Even Terumi Mei's Melting Release could hardly harm it at all.
Terumi Mei felt that her chakra was getting weaker and weaker. She turned her head to see if Emperor Hades had left, but she didn't want to see him standing there blankly looking at Zero Tails when she turned around. Terumi Mei was shocked. This guy could have been frightened. If he didn't escape, then his efforts would have been in vain.
"Asshole, why are you still here? Don't run yet. " Terumi Mei roared.
"Shut up, you stupid girl. Who told you that you thought you were great and stood in front of me? If I were to leave now, would you still be considered a man?" "Underworld Emperor shouted, but his eyes kept rolling around Zero Wei.
"You idiot, let's die together. "The chakra was nearly exhausted. Terumi Mei felt angry and sweet at the same time after hearing Emperor Hades' words. She was annoyed why he didn't run away, but she was also glad that she had not misjudged the person.
Seeing that Terumi Mei was getting weaker and weaker, Retail shook its big head. It looked at the couple in front of it, and its expression became violent again.
Emperor Hades looked at Zero Tail, who was running towards him like a heavy tank, and his eyes gradually turned cold!
Feeling the frightening aura of Emperor Hades, Zero Tails slowed down and stopped ten meters away. Looking at this tiny human, he didn't understand how the weak boy just now became dangerous. Generally, psychic beasts with higher levels have a certain IQ. The higher the level, the higher the IQ. Zero Tails instinctively stopped when he felt the aura of the strong man.
Emperor Hades stared closely at Lingwei, attacking first to gain the upper hand, and attacking later to suffer disaster. "Raiki! "
"Rasengan!" "
The Underworld Emperor used one hand to cut the lightning and the other hand to spin the pill, and finally they were combined together!
Emperor Hades took out a special kunai. Although Flying Thunder God has not yet succeeded, the success rate is still 30%!
Flying Thunder God sends out!
With a bang, Emperor Hades suddenly appeared in front of Zero Tails, with the cold white flame "Fire of Nirvana!" "It struck Zero-Tail's body, and Zero-Tail's huge body flew backwards. Then he felt a chill and looked at Namikaze Hades in horror. What kind of monster was this? Then he ran away in a hurry.
